docs.title: rn-forge-devops
docs.text:
rn-forge-devops holds the release commands for the pykit workspace. The CI planner is kiln's kiln-devops.

It is built from three modules:

  • rn_forge.devops.requirements, the requirements check: every requirement between workspace members is a version range that admits the member's current version and has a ceiling.
  • rn_forge.devops.notes, the umbrella subcommand's logic: the umbrella release for the newest shipped release page.
  • rn_forge.devops.cli, the console script that wires the subcommands.

The package depends on packaging and no other rn-forge package; uv run lint-imports proves it. The facade re-exports nothing.

Use the reference for the subcommands and the API.

docs.title: Changelog
docs.text: Notable changes to rn-forge-devops, newest first, in the Keep a Changelog format.

docs.title: Removed
docs.text:
• Breaking: the planner moved to kiln as kiln-devops. The plan, releasable, released, smoke, adapters, sonar-target and notes subcommands and the modules rn_forge.devops.ci, .uv and .github are gone, and the package facade re-exports nothing. The package keeps the requirements and umbrella subcommands. A consumer of the planner runs kiln's kiln-devops.

  • Breaking: the index subcommand and the rn_forge.devops.index and rn_forge.devops.releases modules. The package index at https://rn-forge.github.io/pykit/simple/ is retired; packages resolve from PyPI. A consumer that still declares the index deletes its [[tool.uv.index]] table and runs uv lock.

docs.title: Fixed
docs.text: • plan no longer hangs on a dependency cycle. Release order and releasable follow dependencies and optional dependencies only, not dependency groups; selection still follows all three. A cycle among the former raises a ValueError naming the packages.

docs.title: Added
docs.text:
• [tool.workspace-ci.redis]: a package's tests run again against a Redis service, with the URL in the variable env names. The plan output gains redis, and the check marker is <package>.redis.
  • The notes subcommand: rn-forge-devops notes CHANGELOG VERSION prints a changelog version's section.
  • The umbrella subcommand: rn-forge-devops umbrella RELEASES_DIR BODY_FILE --site-url URL writes the release notes for the newest shipped release page whose tag is not among the tags read from stdin, and prints its tag= and title= lines.

docs.title: Changed
docs.text: • The package declares the MIT licence and is published to PyPI.

docs.title: Added
docs.text:
• The index subcommand: rn-forge-devops index --repo OWNER/NAME --out DIR writes a PEP 503 simple index of the repository's published rn-forge-* release files.
  • The requirements subcommand: it fails when a workspace member's requirement on another member is a URL, excludes that member's current version or has no upper bound.

docs.title: Changed
docs.text: • A package with no [tool.workspace-ci.smoke] table is still smoke-tested: plan lists its empty-extra smoke entry, releasable requires its <name>.smoke marker, and smoke imports the package's own module.

docs.title: Added
docs.text:
• The rn-forge-devops package: CI and release automation for rn-forge repositories in any language, run with uv. It holds the workspace planner that was .github/scripts/workspace_ci.py, split into a core (rn_forge.devops.ci), a uv workspace adapter (rn_forge.devops.uv), a GitHub Actions adapter (rn_forge.devops.github) and the rn-forge-devops console script (rn_forge.devops.cli).
  • The adapters subcommand and the adapters key of [tool.workspace-ci]: a package lists its adapter names, and the command fails when a name has no module or no extra of the same name, or is repeated.

docs.title: Guides
docs.text:
Run rn-forge-devops requirements from inside a uv workspace. Its root is the nearest directory at or above the current one whose pyproject.toml declares [tool.uv.workspace]. umbrella needs no workspace.

rn-forge-devops requirements
git ls-remote --tags --refs origin | rn-forge-devops umbrella docs/releases release-body.md --site-url https://rn-forge.github.io/pykit/

The subcommands are in the subcommand reference.

docs.title: pending_umbrella(releases_dir, existing_tags, site_url)
docs.text:
Return the umbrella release for the newest shipped release page.

Only the newest page whose | **Status** | row starts with shipped is considered, so older pages are never backfilled.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default releases_dir Path

A directory of release-<n>/index.md pages.

required existing_tags Collection[str]

The repository's existing tag names.

required site_url str

The documentation site's URL, ending in /.

required

Returns:

Type Description Umbrella | None

The umbrella release, or None when no page is shipped or its tag

Umbrella | None

already exists.

docs.title: Subcommands
docs.text:
Run rn-forge-devops from inside a uv workspace. Its root is the nearest directory at or above the current one whose pyproject.toml declares [tool.uv.workspace].

Subcommand Does requirements Checks every requirement from one workspace member on another, in dependencies, optional dependencies and dependency groups: it must not be a URL, must admit the member's current version, and must have a < or <= ceiling. Prints one line per problem to stderr and exits 1 if there are any. umbrella RELEASES_DIR BODY_FILE --site-url URL Reads git ls-remote --tags --refs origin output from stdin. When the newest release-<n> page whose status starts with shipped has no release-<n> tag, writes its ## Shipped section and a link to the page under URL to BODY_FILE, and prints tag= and title= lines. Otherwise prints nothing. Exits 1 if RELEASES_DIR or BODY_FILE is outside the working directory. It does not need a workspace.
